sentences.text: A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on a business-purpose loan to an MSE where the sanctioned amount is up to ₹50 lakh, and this case fits that rule because the loan was sanctioned on 15 March 2026 and the amount is ₹40 lakh.
The older floating-rate pre-payment charge directions were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23, so the current UCB rule controls.
